Name: Lowell and the Hidden Place
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[left][size=4][b]Lowell and the Hidden Place[/b][/size][/left]
[left][b]Note: [/b]This mod can be installed mid-playthrough, but the plot and progression rely heavily on the Community Center restoration.[b]  [size=3]A new save is highly recommended for the best experience![/size]

[/b][/left]
[left][size=3][b]Please read before downloading to see if this mod fits your playstyle:[/b][/size][/left]
[left]Lowell and the Hidden Place is designed as a low-stakes, slow-paced experience. It features no cinematic drama, world-ending threats, or epic conflicts. Instead, it centers around a bunch of little cuties and a hermit of a man willing to spend years in isolation waiting for his friends. They stay within their custom location most of the time and won't force themselves into the spotlight.
[b]Junimo Lore[/b]: Since SDV lore is open to interpretation and many mods create their own storylines, my take focuses purely on the ecosystem of this mod. I wanted to expand the world without changing or heavily altering the vanilla lore (or at least, how I perceive it).
[b]JojaMart Route[/b]: The Junimos will be deeply upset if you side with Joja Corp. Please don't do that.  Just, play along with me - if you plan a Joja run, save this mod for another playthrough! [/left]
[center][left][spoiler]Currently, the Joja route simply closes the portal. Any NPCs you've already met and items you've obtained will remain in your game, as I haven't found a safe way to remove everything mid-game without risking save corruption.[/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
[left][b]If you're still with me:[/b][/left]
[left][u]After you unlock the Community Center door and drink the Wizard's potion, a mysterious portal leading to the Hidden Place will appear in town, right behind the playground.[/u][/left]

[left][b]Features At A Glance[/b][/left]
[left]✓ New location - changes slightly with Community Center progress.[/left]
[left]✓ Over 40 events in total (Check Articles for the Event Guide.)[/left]
[left]✓ New content - custom tea, new recipes, 2 fruit trees, 3 new crops (one unlocks a special endgame crafting chain for the most patient farmers), 2 buffs, some new furniture, 2 new buildings from Robin, a new fish, and much more.[/left]
[left]✓ New quests and special orders - mostly given directly to you, plus 1 special order on the billboard.[/left]
[left]✓ A bunch of new letters - including letters from vanilla villagers reacting to your Community Center progress.[/left]
[left]✓ Barter shop[/left]
[left]✓ Rare collections - a small collection of Junimo decor and paintings.[/left]
[left][b]✓ New NPCs - including 3 Anti-social ones, as well as:[/b][/left]

[left][b]✓ A new romanceable NPC [/b]with seasonal portraits and sprites.[/left]
[left]• [u]Name[/u]: Lowell.   [u]Age[/u]: Adult man, forever 35.  [u]Birthday[/u]: Spring 20.[/left]
[left]• Polite craftsman who has spent years in isolation. He masks his initial awkwardness with a charmingly dry, self-deprecating humor. He is an accidental bibliophile, self-taught guitarist, and a massive dark tea lover. He acts as a protective, deeply caring older brother figure to the little spirits.[/left]
[center][left]• Gifts:  
[spoiler]Love: Sky-in-a-Cup Tea, Forest Spirit Prism, Four Seasons Medley, vegetables, Vegetable Medley, Spring Onion, Blackberry, Blackberry Cobbler, books
Like: fruits, flowers, Poppy, Salmonberry, Raisins, Tea Sapling, Green Tea, Tea Leaves, Fried Mushroom
Dislike: gems, Prismatic Shard, fish, Fish Taco, Salmon Dinner, Sashimi, Maki Roll, Fish Stew, Escargot, Lobster Bisque, Crab Cakes, Shrimp Cocktail, Roe, Squid Ink Ravioli, Pale Ale, Beer, Wine, Mead, Ginger Ale, Cookies
Hate: Magic Rock Candy, Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Ice Cream, Miner's Treat, Sugar, Honey, Blueberry Tart, Cranberry Candy, Maple Bar, Strange Bun[/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
[center][left]• Over 500 lines of dialogue that adapt as your friendship grows. Includes custom gift reactions, location-specific lines, scheduled conversations, and movie reactions. 
[spoiler]Loved Movies: Natural Wonders, Wumbus, Miracle at Coldstar Ranch
Liked Movies: Brave Little Sapling, Mysterium
Disliked Movies: Prairie King, It Howls in the Rain, Zuzu City Express
Loved Snacks: Apple Slices, Hummus Snack pack, Jasmine Tea, Panzanella Salad)[/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
[center][left]• Schedule: He is easy to find either in the Hidden Place or in his tent (especially on rainy days). However, his schedule changes as you progress. 
[spoiler] On Thursdays, you can find him at his clearing. He'll also start visiting the town and the mountains. On Fridays, he helps Robin.[/spoiler]
[/left]
[/center]
[left]• His personal storyline unfolds across a chain of 8 heart events.[/left]
[left]• He rarely attends festivals, [i]this is my design choice (and his, of course!)[/i]. However, once you reach higher friendship levels, you'll spot him at the Fair and Spirit's Eve.[/left]
[left][b]• Romance: [/b] [u]Everything after you give him the bouquet is strictly romantic content.[/u][/left]
[left][b]•  Marriage:   !!! He will accept the Mermaid's Pendant ONLY after the Community Center is fully restored and the Junimo return quests are completed !!! [/b][/left]
[left]*  Over 500 lines of unique dialogue, including custom spouse chores, dialogue split by season and relationship (different lines for under 9 hearts vs. 10+ hearts). Expect a few spicy lines, they are staying true to the vanilla game vibe.[/left]
[left]*  After marriage, he will leave the farm 4 sunny days a week to do his own things.[/left]
[left]*  There are around 12 events dedicated to romance and post-marriage life, along with a custom wedding ceremony and unique cutscenes when the player 'dies'.[/left]
[left]*  You can sleep and save in his bed once you are married![/left]
[left]*  While dating, he will attend the Flower Dance, and once married, he'll start joining you for the Feast of the Winter Star.[/left]

[left][b]✓  6 Junimo NPCs[/b][/left]
[left]• Restoring rooms in the Community Center will gradually bring the Junimos back home.[/left]
[left]• Each Junimo has their own distinct personality, gift preferences, and over 100 unique lines of dialogue. [b]Please note: their dialogue includes a few intentionally misspelled words. This is completely by design![/b][/left]
[left]• At 10 hearts, each Junimo will offer a special quest with a memorable reward.[/left]
[left]• Look forward to seasonal quests (starting in the first Winter after the CC is restored).[/left]
[left]• They follow schedules that change with the progress, but they always remain within the Hidden Place.[/left]
[left][u]• Most of the mod's content unlocks as you meet and build friendship with the Junimos.[/u][/left]
[left][b]Meet the Junimos:[/b][/left]
[left][b]Taupe[/b] (Boiler Room) – A curious Junimo who is fascinated by rocks, stars, and crafting. He loves to spend his evenings looking through his telescope.[/left]
[left][b]Sapphy[/b] (Fish Tank) – A cheerful, empathetic Junimo. She is absolutely obsessed with 'waterr', fish, and splashing.[/left]
[left][b]Verdee[/b] (Pantry) – An energetic, messy, and deeply passionate little gardener. He loves everything about farming, seeds, soil, and plants, and enjoys experimenting with magic.[/left]
[left][b]Mauve[/b] (Crafts Room) – A quiet, sensitive, and deeply artistic Junimo who sees the world as a giant canvas. She is completely captivated by colors, butterflies, and music.[/left]
[left][b]Rubee[/b] (Bulletin Board) – An energetic, talkative, and playful Junimo who is deeply fascinated by everything humans do. Rubee raises blue chickens and can't sit still for long.[/left]
[left][b]Gold[/b] (Vault) – A sharp, business-minded little merchant who runs the barter shop. He is obsessed with trades, unique treasures, and the legendary "Big Junimo Race".[/left]
[left][u]• Giving the right loved or liked gifts will grant you more friendship points than usual, or even trigger return gifts! I highly encourage trying to figure them out on your own. However, since dialogue lines are randomized, I'll put all gift under spoiler.  [/u]
[spoiler][u]Taupe - Love: Neptunite, Like: Lunarite,
[/u][u][u]Sapphy - Love: Dried Starfish, Like: Rainbow Shell,[/u][/u]
[u]Verdee - Love: Banana, Like Cactus Fruit,[/u]
[u]Mauve - Love: Ancient Drum, Like: fire opal,[/u]
[u]Rubee - Love: Friendship 101, Like: Horse: The Book,[/u]
[u]Gold - Love: Rusty Spoon, Like: Dwarvish Helm[/u][/spoiler]
[/left]
[center][/center]
[left][b][size=4]Configuration Options:[/size][/b][/left]
[left]I highly recommend installing [url=www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for easy setup. You can choose:[/left]
[left]• whether you want to see Junimos on the social tab. "Default": "HiddenAlways"[/left]
[left]• 'Include or Exclude' custom items from this mod to count toward 100% Perfection. "Default": "Exclude"[/left]
[left]• Wedding SetUp, 'Standard' keeps the default town square ceremony. 'Custom' features a private ceremony with Junimos. "Default": "Custom"[/left]
[left]• The event after player's 'death'. 'Standard' keeps vanilla rescue scenes, while 'Custom' replaces them (with or without item/gold loss). "Default": "Custom without Penalties"[/left]
[left]• The romantic nickname that Lowell will use for you. "Default": "Kismet"[/left]

[left][b]Cross-Mod Content:[/b][/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]• SVE[/url]: Features one short custom cutscene with Abigail.[/left]
[left]• Lowell has some gift tastes for items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33203]Book Collecting (SNF)[/url] and SVE, as well as one highly specific item from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38698]Pelican Town Municipal - Custom NPC[/url] :).[/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43723]• Birthday Redux Reworked Revamped (BRRR) Birthday Conversation Topic and Game State Query [/url]- Lowell will wish you a happy birthday, and if you are married to him, you will unlock a repeatable custom birthday event.[/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]• Wedding Anniversaries[/url] - Features custom dialogue and anniversary gifts.[/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49526]• Campgrounds[/url] - Lowell has custom responses when invited to camping.[/left]

[left][b][size=4]Compatibility: Please read this section carefully before installing.[/size][/b][/left]
[left][b]SVE and other large expansions[/b]: Technically, there shouldn't be any issues. I used coordinates from both vanilla and SVE maps for events and schedules, so everything should work smoothly. 
[spoiler] I play on an old laptop, and on an Android device that finds these massive expansions a bit too hot to handle, so my testing was limited. I also don't know the lore of those mods, so I can't say if my mod fits cohesively or breaks your immersion.[/spoiler]
[/left]
[center][/center]
[left][b][b]Android:[/b][/b] Everything should work fine. I found a couple of minor bugs during testing, but they aren't game-breaking, and you probably won't even notice them. [u]The only major thing: in event that trigger by entering a location with a quest item in your inventory, you actually need to hold the item above your head and tap to warp into that location.[/u][/left]

[left][b]Incompatible By Design[/b][/left]
[left][b][b]Free Love & PolyamorySweet:[/b][/b] Lowell is strictly monogamous due to his lore and personality. No specific compatibility or troubleshooting is planned for these mods. On its own, my mod will not affect those mods if you have them installed.[/left]
[left][b][b]Platonic Relationships: [/b][/b]No specific compatibility is planned. Lowell's personal story arc wraps up at 8 hearts. Everything after the bouquet (9+ hearts) is strictly designed as a romantic bonus.[/left]

[left][b]Incompatible Due to My Skill Issues[/b][/left]
[left]I couldn't figure out how to make a minimap to save my life. Sorry![/left]
[left][b][b]Recolors: [/b]Since my map uses a mix of custom and vanilla tiles, it will look broken with recolor mods.[/b][/left]

[left][b]Might be Incompatible for Immersion Reasons[/b][/left]
[left][b][b]Major Map Overhauls:[/b][/b] Some events were built strictly around the vanilla and SVE map layouts for locations like the Mountain, Backwoods, Town, and Forest. With popular map overhauls, you might experience a visual clash, or characters might temporarily stand in displaced bushes or on paths that don't match your map mod. 
[spoiler] Are patches planned? Yes, but they are waaay down on my priority list right now. Compatibility patches for map overhauls require writing second (or even more) versions of the same events, changing coordinates, movements, and so on. Some mods alter maps too drastically. While I could technically bypass this with temporary maps, there will never be 100% immersion with them. I'm sorry, but I'm not ready to give up on my ideas and content (whatever it may be) just to fit into someone else's maps.[/spoiler]
[/left]
[left][b][b]Multiplayer (Untested) [/b][/b]Since I don't play multiplayer, I have absolutely no clue how my mod will behave or what needs to be fixed to make it compatible.[/left]

[left][b][size=4]Translations: [/size][/b][/left]
[left]Currently, the mod supports:[/left]
[left]English[/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52950]Russian[/url][/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52990]Turkish[/url] - Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110112618]xyploc[/url] [/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53095?tab=description]Spanish[/url] - Huge thanks to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/240830798]Rupnan[/url][/left]
[left]If you want to translate it into other languages, feel free to do so without asking!  [b]NOTE: For compatibility with the popular Wizard-to-Witch mod, I had to use a dynamic token.  This means you will need to translate literally just 2 words inside the content.json file and include it in your translation mod.  Check the "Preview file contents" of my Russian translation to see how the file structure should look if you need it.  [/b][/left]
[left]Just make sure to upload only the files necessary for the translation and set my mod as a dependency. Thank you in advance! Feel free to ask if you need any help. I know I'm messy in the code. [/left]

[left]A Few more words from me: This is my first mod of this scale. I learned pretty much everything on the fly, including pixel art for portraits, sprites, and dialogue writing. The mod is fully complete. While I might add some small bits of content in the future if inspiration strikes, I’ve already implemented everything I originally planned. For now, my main focus will be fixing bugs and prepping for the upcoming 1.7 update. So Please be gentle![/left]
[left][b]I really hope you enjoy it.[/b][/left]
[center][left]
[/left]
